description: IPS packages are the native packages in Solaris 11 and higher.

parameters.name: enabled
parameters.description: Is the repository enabled or disabled? Choices: false true

parameters.name: mirror
parameters.description: A path or URL to the repository mirror. Multiple values may be provided.

parameters.name: origin
parameters.description: A path or URL to the repository. Multiple values may be provided.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Whether to ensure that a publisher is present or absent. Choices: "present" ← (default) "absent"

parameters.name: sticky
parameters.description: Packages installed from a sticky repository can only receive updates from that repository. Choices: false true

examples:
- name: Fetch packages for the solaris publisher direct from Oracle
  community.general.pkg5_publisher:
    name: solaris
    sticky: true
    origin: https://pkg.oracle.com/solaris/support/

- name: Configure a publisher for locally-produced packages
  community.general.pkg5_publisher:
    name: site
    origin: 'https://pkg.example.com/site/'
